title: Software-Engineering-as-an-Artifact: From Engines to Systems That Build Themselves
abstract: arXiv:2611.30247v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software engineering (SE) is evolving rapidly as generative AI and LLM-based agents grow more capable. Yet, as a community, we risk using these new tools to solve problems that a changing SE process may no longer pose. We consider how AI may transform, and in part already is transforming, both the SE process and the systems it produces. Drawing on scenario planning methods from futures studies, we extrapolate from observed trends to a deliberately extreme scenario in which the SE process fully materializes in artifacts (like context documentation and executable skills). Such a process would culminate in SE engines that autonomously produce and update systems directly from requirements and user requests. The work of human engineers would then shift from the product to the process: they would maintain the artifacts of these engines, while the engines produce and evolve the software. We probe this scenario in scenario-validation interviews

translated_title: 作为制品的软件工程：从引擎到能够自我构建的系统
translated_abstract: 随着生成式AI和基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体能力不断增强，软件工程（SE）正在迅速演变。然而，作为一个研究社区，我们面临着用这些新工具去解决一个不断变化的软件工程流程可能不再存在的问题的风险。我们探讨了AI可能如何变革——部分已经在变革——软件工程流程及其产出的系统。借鉴未来学研究中的情景规划方法，我们从观察到的趋势外推到一个刻意设定的极端情景：在该情景中，软件工程流程完全物化为制品（如上下文文档和可执行技能）。这样的流程最终将催生软件工程引擎，能够直接根据需求和用户请求自主生成并更新系统。届时，人类工程师的工作将随之从产品转向流程：他们将维护这些引擎的制品，而由引擎来生产和演进软件。我们通过情景验证访谈来探究这一情景。
tldr: 该论文借鉴未来学的情景规划方法，提出一个极端情景：软件工程流程将完全物化为制品（如上下文文档和可执行技能），最终形成能从需求自主生成和更新软件的软件工程引擎，人类工程师的角色将从开发软件产品转向维护这些流程制品。
